falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically featured shallow, brief pullbacks before continuation; a close below 4,800 would break the structural support level established in that pattern and invalidate the 80% similarity match, suggesting this is not a true bottom formation but rather a distribution phase

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom pattern occurred with VIX peaking near 23 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained VIX above 25 indicates panic selling and regime change to risk-off that contradicts the controlled consolidation characteristic of the matched pattern, proving the current signal is not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield exceeds 2Y yield by more than 10 basis points) and holds for 3+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern maintained curve inversion as a macro backdrop; curve uninversion with sustained duration signals recession pricing and forced deleveraging, which would mean the current 39 blowoff score reflects exhaustion rather than accumulation, invalidating the bottom call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
